scope: Same red dragon and seed; experimental engagement steering differs from earlier cautious/reposition inputs, so completion times are not a controlled before/after comparison. Fixed Next uses the chosen reading policy. Slow while turning or within 45 horizontal units; approach at normal speed once aligned. If the same target within 40 horizontal units remains outside the actual aim arc without HP loss for 2.4s, depart for 1.4s. Departure is level when safe, climbing only for sampled forward terrain clearance. All steering uses ordinary key/mouse events; game HP, positions, RNG, attacks and clocks are unchanged.
